proposed_capability: Correct semantic conflation between context-sensitive Escape cancellation / conditional Options menu and the independently documented P/0 game-time pause; preserve Get Together-gated U Clubs panel semantics. Harden existing Win32 injected chord release after an aborted sequence and publish read-only operator-host fault isolation. Do not change Windows key mapping, accessibility, Bluetooth, screenshot or OS hooks. Repository fixes are not proof of live-game resolution or Cursor session attribution.
player_save_control_impact: Pure contract, source-level keyboard send balancing, negative tests and manual read-only triage. Does not install keyboard interceptors, change host input preferences, write EA saves, start TS4 or operate user devices.
expected_outcome: Preserve Esc cancel/menu as context-dependent with zero direct pause guarantee, P actual time pause only with observed playing precondition, U Clubs only when pack is attested, synthetic chord release on errors, and a host evidence matrix that distinguishes game UI interception, game defect, mods, and external agents without asserting causal attribution.
negative_tests: ESC is not considered a direct game-time pause key
P remains explicitly non-idempotent with PLAYING precondition
U remains pack-gated and never OS-remapped
Aborted synthetic modifier chord releases keys it pressed in reverse order
No global keyboard hook, OS preference write, game input dispatch or save mutation from these changes
rollback_path: Revert bounded PR to restore prior contract labels and key-dispatch behavior. Do not touch Windows host settings or saves. BI-002 and local Windows input certification remain open.
unresolved_unknowns: No authenticated Cursor conversation/tool logs or physical keystroke trace; commit metadata cannot identify who altered the user's desktop
On-host options menu versus direct pause and Get Together/U tests remain operator-host only
External agent unbalanced physical/direct input and mod UI consumption remain independently possible
